title: Soy-Marinated Jammy Eggs
summary: Six-and-a-half-minute eggs soaked in soy and mirin for rice bowls.

ingredients.item: garlic clove or slice of ginger

steps.title: Mix the marinade
steps.text: Stir the soy sauce, mirin, water, and sugar and aromatic if using in a zip-top bag or container.

steps.title: Boil
steps.text: Bring a large pot of water to a full boil. Lower in the cold eggs with a spoon and cook 6 1/2 minutes for jammy yolks. If the pot is small and the water stops boiling for long, go to 7.

steps.title: Ice bath
steps.text: Move the eggs straight into a big bowl of ice water to stop the cooking and make them easier to peel.

steps.title: Peel
steps.text: Crack both ends, roll gently on the counter, and peel, under water if they stick. Soft eggs are fragile.

steps.title: Marinate
steps.text: Submerge the eggs in the marinade, press out the air, and refrigerate at least 2 hours. Overnight gives darker, saltier eggs with firmer yolks.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Halve lengthwise and set yolk-up on the bowls.

notes: The marinade is good for one more batch within a few days. Start these first; they need the longest lead time of anything in the bowls.
